blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine peso slides further and goes past 64 per dollar for the first time on Tuesday, setting another record low. This developed as mounting economic uncertainty and external pressures fueled bets that the currency could weaken further to 65. Data from the Bankers Association of the Philippines show the local unit lost 22 centavos to close at 64.17 versus the greenback. This surpassed the prior all-time low closing of 63.95 set on Monday.
